overview_description.description: StateSpace provides performance analytics and a suite of tools for casual gamers and esports athletes to maximize their potential. It uses cognitive science and artificial intelligence to revolutionize the way humans improve. Leveraging expertise as neuroscientists, data scientists, video game developers, and computer visionaries, the products bring much needed standardized performance analytics to train.It was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

about_short_description.short_description: Statespace provides performance analytics and a suite of tools for casual gamers and esports athletes to maximize their potential.

product.name: Aimlabs
product.description: An AI-powered aim-training platform for FPS players that provides practice tasks, game-specific training, performance analytics, personalized feedback, leaderboards, and sensitivity tools.

product.name: Aimlabs+
product.description: A paid membership for Aimlabs that provides access to advanced training and coaching features, including sensitivity analysis, guided programs, adaptive tasks, AI coaching, and community chat.

product.name: Aimlabs Academy
product.description: An educational service within Aimlabs that provides interactive learning plans and video courses from esports coaches and professional players.
